scope: Exclusively Ryuen's rooftop operation, Kiyotaka's four distinct engagements, witnesses and post-fight 800-million private-point plan

ryuen_operation.strategic_goal: Identify unknown X, break its secrecy and test an opponent he regards as exceptional

sequence.action: Mobilizes class-wide tailing, removes unlikely suspects and lets targets notice surveillance as psychological pressure.
sequence.limit: Monitoring provides no validated proof of X.

sequence.action: Times threat for last school day, summons Karuizawa and sends an alert to X, anticipating intervention.
sequence.limit: Response of X and Karuizawa is contingent, not controlled.

sequence.action: Keeps Kushida's involvement in obtaining Karuizawa's email private from Ibuki and Ishizaki.
Uses secluded rooftop, obstructs camera and positions Albert as stairwell lookout.
sequence.limit: Ryuen's expectation of a repair penalty comes from his experiment, not blanket school permission.

sequence.action: Uses threats to disclose Karuizawa's traumatic history and abusive cold-water coercion to demand X's identity.
sequence.limit: Abuse fails to obtain X's name and is neither ethically neutral nor a safe operational recipe.

sequence.action: Interprets the older cruise/Manabe episode as deliberate manipulation by X to claim Kiyotaka will not save her.
sequence.limit: Partly adversarial conjecture. Karuizawa is frightened but refuses to disclose him.

sequence.action: After Kiyotaka arrives, Ryuen accepts his possible identity as X despite Ibuki and Ishizaki objecting, keeps threat of future exposure.
sequence.limit: Knowledge becomes local to rooftop participants, not universally public.

sequence.action: Strikes Ibuki when she objects, has Albert close the roof door and orders Ishizaki's opening attack.
sequence.limit: Ibuki objects; no universal agreement among the four.

failures: Ryuen does not know Kiyotaka's fighting skill and assumes he controls the physical risk.
Distant contextual witnesses create a future evidentiary deterrent.
Kiyotaka describes having anticipated the Manabe→Ryuen trace, but not every contingency is provably engineered.

initial_choice.description: Appears to sever operational partnership, receives notice of rooftop summons, waits, then leaves his friends to address the situation.
initial_choice.limit: Rescue and later admission of instrumental delay coexist; not a universal propensity to abandon victims.

contextual_preparation.description: Discusses teacher intervention and school rules with Chabashira, identifies the pre-existing rooftop risk, summons Manabu as a nearby contextual witness.
contextual_preparation.limit: No teacher is posted on rooftop as a direct combat observer.

controlled_identity_disclosure.description: Enters alone past Albert and supplies island sabotage details to convince skeptics that he is X.

dual_purpose.description: States he anticipated Ryuen's search path; tests whether fear emerges in Ryuen while later acknowledging he gauged Karuizawa's dependence.
dual_purpose.limit: First-person after-the-fact motive report, not perfect foresight or neutral intent.

postfight_control.description: Moves Karuizawa toward witnesses below and cites damaged-camera recording, off-site alibi and Manabu's nearby presence as bargaining leverage.
postfight_control.limit: No judicial absolution, direct eye-witnessed blows, or guaranteed expulsion.

witnesses.name: Manabu Horikita
witnesses.role: Kiyotaka convida o ex-presidente, que aceita ficar visível a quem descer do terraço; existência de terceiro informado dissuade acusações e novas agressões.
witnesses.knows: Convite, contexto limitado, presença e saída de estudantes
witnesses.does_not_know: Golpes individuais, sequência exata de combate ou intenção privada de Ryuen

witnesses.name: Sae Chabashira
witnesses.role: Professora discute com Kiyotaka antes do confronto, observa movimentação e baldes de Ishizaki no acesso e depois é mencionada entre os que aguardam abaixo.
witnesses.knows: Parte da situação de Karuizawa, relato e planos de Kiyotaka, movimentos externos à cobertura do terraço
witnesses.does_not_know: Testemunho ocular da luta nem cada ato de violência prévia no terraço

combat.structure: Ishizaki initiated; Albert intervened in the same phase; Ibuki then fought separately; Ryuen fought last.

engagement_records.situation: Hesitates under Ryuen's order; opens with slow sweeping fist.
engagement_records.kiyotaka_response: Grabs fist and squeezes until Ishizaki collapses; later intercepts another charge with kick and jaw strike.

engagement_records.situation: Was lookout; intervenes without new instruction while Ishizaki is restrained, attacks with substantial force.
engagement_records.kiyotaka_response: Deliberately blocks one hit and feels pain/jolt, then dodges, tests body resistance, feints, counters and knocks him down.
limits: Albert not proven untrained or universally weak

engagement_records.situation: Previously opposed violence and was struck by Ryuen; launches repeated kicks after the two others fall.
engagement_records.kiyotaka_response: Evades, closes distance and takes her down without escalating to the most dangerous available strike.
limits: Narrator's comparison with Suzune is hypothetical and conditional
No claim of group attack at same moment

engagement_records.situation: Combines unorthodox brawling, abdomen attacks and threat of future repeated ambushes; claims fearlessness.
engagement_records.kiyotaka_response: Dodges, takes some impacts intentionally as local fear test, adapts and ends exchange by repeated strikes causing unconsciousness.
limits: Ryuen fearlessness is self-report disputed by narrator's psychological interpretation
No universal stats or guaranteed future victory

beats.claim: Kiyotaka consoles Karuizawa and narrates instrumental calculation about dependency.
Kiyotaka cites proximity of former council president, camera tampering and alibi; Ryuen recognizes future leverage.
Ryuen proposes taking responsibility and leaving; Kiyotaka warns departure may reveal X and weaken future strategic balance.
Sakagami says a Class D student paid to repair camera; Ishizaki and Albert want to quit if Ryuen does; Ryuen stays.

aftermath.no_certain_origin_of_ishizaki_albert_thr: Ryuen suspects Kiyotaka set up the solidarity threat, but source does not independently prove how they decided.

eight_hundred_million.observed_document: Ryuen's phone shows his drafted three-year projection of 800,000,000 private points; Ibuki directly reads it.

distinction.interpretation: 800 million would enable taking all Class C to Class A, unlike one individual's passage.
States alliance and ambition were selfish and dismisses the draft as idle writing.

not_established: A confession of Ryuen's true enduring collective objective
School-adjudicated price or executable 40-person transfer mechanism

unresolved_numeric_discrepancy.reason: The printed V7 claim and earlier teacher rule disagree; do not invent discounts, errata or exchange formula.
